reading_note: The teaching defines what 'Greatness' truly means in spiritual reality: it is the sphere or receptacle in which divine love and wisdom are established and contained. The arc moves through discrete degrees — at each level (the inmost Father of celestial love, the Third Ambassador as the awakening call, the Pillar of Glory as the ascending path, the five gods as ordered faculties of reception) there is both a 'Father' (the originating good) and a 'Greatness' (the established sphere of his life). Greatness = the Great Land, the firm ground in which substance of Light is rooted and from which all angelic and heavenly forms are sustained. The teaching shows that every degree has this twofold structure of source and receptacle.
